scoringMethod: API behavior +3, UI cosmetic +1. No DB schema, auth, payment, multi-tenant, production env, or destructive factors. Distinct areas summed (3 + 1 = 4).

factors.notes: New admin endpoints: OfferEnrichmentsController (4 routes) + ContentDraftsController (6 routes). All use AdminApiKeyGuard. No publish endpoint exposed. Reuses existing AiRun and ArticleDraft models. Offer enrichments stored as AiRun JSON (no schema change).
Dashboard extension: three new panels (Ready for Enrichment, Offer Enrichments, Article Drafts). Reuses existing Panel/TableHeader/StatusBadge/ActionButton patterns. No new design tokens.
No schema change. Offer enrichments use existing AiRun model. Content drafts use existing ArticleDraft model. No new tables or columns.
No auth or role changes. All new endpoints use existing AdminApiKeyGuard.
No multi-tenant changes. Single-tenant admin surface.
No environment, infra, or deployment changes.
No destructive operations. All changes are additive: new controllers, new services, new tests, new UI sections.
